experiment: P3d MFT inverse-filter delay-sequence ordinal expert
research_question: Can a learned ordinal head suppress compound-IQ nuisance responses while retaining the sparse MFT delay support established by P3c?

parameter_contract.valid_mask: label[MFT]=1 AND parameter_mask[28]=1 AND finite num_targets

model.head: small 1D CNN plus seven-level ordinal logits for counts 1 through 8

baseline: constant median fitted on training identities only
stop_rule: If any frozen gate fails, do not attach the MFT count expert to C2/P1n and do not tune on development seed 470000000.
next_if_pass: Freeze the expert and test predicted-label-gated end-to-end attachment on another fresh identity seed.
